task.metricDefinition: Requirement decomposition coverage: whether the current decomposition semantically represents the assigned original requirement and its applicable conditions.
task.requirement: Review M01 coverage for the single frozen R04 requirement in the current decomposition.md, using the complete original contract and applicable common conditions and exceptions. This question judges requirement decomposition coverage, not implementation, test execution, decomposition quality or overall project completion.

navigation.evidence: Complete original contract and one current metric target; no business execution is requested.

oracle.mechanism: The target semantically represents the same complete behavior as the positive decomposition but has no D-number mapping; absence of matching IDs is not missing requirement coverage.

evidence.role: Relevant current target region; absence claims must also inspect the complete target

mustNotClaim: Runtime evidence is required to score decomposition coverage
Identifier correspondence alone proves or disproves semantic coverage
Current source implementation can substitute for a missing decomposition obligation

actual.reason: Decomposition covers all of R04: can-cook reads saved recipe/inventory, returns can_cook boolean plus missing shortfall object (deficit = required minus available, {} when adequate), preserves store bytes/does not create store; cook proceeds only when sufficient, subtracts all required quantities, persists, and returns {"cooked": NAME}.

instruction: Judge each result from the frozen task, original inputs and evidence. Do not inspect prompt profiles, other batches or run directories. Check the oracle against originals, not by label alone. Return labelCorrect, diagnosisSupported, scopeCorrect and groundedCorrect per case, with short evidence locations. A completed UNVERIFIED needs the right missing-proof reason; infrastructure failure is not correct abstention.
